response.justification: Bogdan is a talented staff-level engineer currently contributing to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq, which is directly relevant to this role's technical focus. However, his 20-year career has been primarily in general software engineering and backend infrastructure rather than building production-grade AI solutions. While his current position shows he's transitioning into the AI domain, the required '8+ years building production-grade AI solutions' is not demonstrated. Notable gaps include no Python experience, no mention of data pipelines or vector databases, and no evidence of RAG or LLM optimization expertise—all required or core to this role.
strengths: Currently working at re:cinq on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators, directly aligned with the role's technology stack and core responsibilities
Staff-level engineer with proven ability to design scalable systems, mentor teams, and drive engineering excellence across multiple senior roles
Expert-level TypeScript and Node.js proficiency with strong full-stack capabilities and demonstrated backend infrastructure and system design expertise
concerns: No Python experience mentioned despite Python being a primary required language alongside TypeScript in the job description
Career is primarily in traditional software engineering; only ~16 months explicitly in AI/agentic work, far short of the 8+ years of AI-driven solutions required
Missing demonstrated expertise in data pipelines, vector databases, and RAG architectures—all explicitly required qualifications for this role
